messages:
sara_nguyen: Hey team — CedarPoint Health opened an urgent support case. Their eDiscovery export for audit logs is failing with a 403 and the exported ZIP is missing the 2024-11-03..2024-11-10 window. They invoked the HIPAA addendum and want an attestation that no data was lost. Ticket #SUP-8421.

mike_chen: Can you paste the CLI call they used and the response body? 403 usually means permission/KMS key access or an expired presigned link.

sara_nguyen: They used the console export button but I asked them to try CLI and they ran: `redwood-cli exports download --id exp_0x9a7 --dest ./cedar.zip` and got this:
```
{\n  "error": "forbidden",\n  "status": 403,\n  "message": "service account does not have kms:Decrypt on key projects/cedar-ctx/keys/hipaa-hsm"\n}
```

jessica_ramirez: :eyes: that points at a KMS ACL issue or a recent key rotation. Did CedarPoint request a KMS key rotation or did we rotate keys last week for the HIPAA pool?

anika_patel: Our change log shows an automated HSM key rotation for `hipaa-hsm` on 1994999000, but only for the hosted-prod cluster. Dedicated customers should be unaffected unless they used our managed key. Is CedarPoint on managed keys or bringing their own?

sara_nguyen: They're on Redwood-managed KMS under the BAA addendum. Customer says they didn't change anything. They also attached a partial export ZIP that has top-level index.json and logs up to 2024-11-02. Missing 11/03-11/10.

mike_chen: Okay escalate to security/infra. @jessica_ramirez can you check key rotation logs + HSM replication status? We need to confirm whether re-encryption or key versioning left some objects encrypted under an older key version that the export service couldn't decrypt.

jessica_ramirez: On it. Pulling KMS audit logs for key `hipaa-hsm`... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

audit-bot: KMS:Decrypt denied for serviceAccount:exporter@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com on key hipaa-hsm at 1995000102 (request id r-0f3a).

jessica_ramirez: Found failed decrypts around 1995000102-1995000450 when export jobs ran. Looks like the exporter SA didn't get updated bindings for the new key version. I can see successful decrypts before the rotation and after a manual rebind at 1995001200.

anika_patel: So that explains the 403 and the partial export. The missing objects were written but couldn't be decrypted during the export window. After manual rebind some retries succeeded. We need to: 1) provide timelines to CedarPoint; 2) surface affected object list; 3) provide HSM attestation and remediation steps.

sara_nguyen: Customer asks whether PHI was at risk and if we can provide a signed attestation that no plaintext left our HSM during rotation. Also they want a full export of the missing date range ASAP.

mike_chen: For risk: if decrypt failed, data remained encrypted at rest and within HSM — no plaintext leaked externally. But legal/security should confirm wording. @anika_patel can you prepare a short technical statement for security + legal that we can convert to an attestation? Keep it explicit about key material never leaving HSM and failed export attempts were due to SA missing decrypt permission.

anika_patel: Will draft. Also provisioning an expedited export job that retries the missing object list after confirming SA binding. ETA 2 hours for a verified export and checksum comparison.

sara_nguyen: Sent CedarPoint an interim update: "We're investigating. Possible root cause: key rotation for managed HIPAA KMS; no evidence of plaintext exfiltration; full export underway." They replied :pray: asking for an attestation doc and timeline.

mike_chen: Ops action items: (1) engineering to run a one-off reexport with forced decryption and generate checksums; (2) infra to audit for any other customers that used exporter SA during rotation window; (3) create playbook entry to auto-rebind exporter SA when managed KMS rotates.

jessica_ramirez: I'll run the reexport job now. Command: `exporter --retry-missing --key-version latest --objects-list missing_objs_8421.txt` then `sha256sum cedar_reexport.zip`. I'll push logs here.

audit-bot: Export job exp_retry_1995001300 started by jessica_ramirez.

jessica_ramirez: Export finished. `sha256sum cedar_reexport.zip` -> `d2f5b8...` ; file size 1.2GB. Contents include 2024-11-03..11-10. Checksums validated against object store after successful decrypt.

anika_patel: Drafted attestation: "Redwood Inference confirms that during the automated rotation of the managed HIPAA KMS key 'hipaa-hsm' on 1994999000, key material remained within the customer's HSM-backed key store; there is no evidence of plaintext export or exfiltration. A temporary binding gap caused the export service account to be denied Decrypt permission between 1995000102 and 1995001200, resulting in partial export failures. All missing records were successfully re-exported on 1995001300 and checksums match the object store."

anika_patel: I'll put this through security/legal review and attach our HSM attestation certificate.

sara_nguyen: Thanks. I'll update the customer and close the loop after legal signs off. Do we want a postmortem and a rollout of the auto-rebind playbook?

mike_chen: Yes — create an incident in postmortems and assign runbook PR to eng-infra. Tag me and jessica. :+1:
